Container.Name: streetsweep-worker
Container.Overview: StreetSweep background worker: ridden-roads recomputes, stats recomputes and Strava athlete syncs queued by the web app on Fly. Never receives public traffic.
Container.Description: StreetSweep background worker: ridden-roads recomputes, stats recomputes and Strava athlete syncs queued by the web app on Fly.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Prod Postgres connection string, pointed at Nastromo's LAN IP (database: postgres).

Config.Name: Overpass URL
Config.Description: Self-hosted Overpass API endpoint on the LAN.

Config.Name: Account Token Encryption Key
Config.Description: Must exactly match the Fly app's value; decrypts users' stored Strava tokens.

Config.Name: Internal Worker Secret
Config.Description: Any random string; only used between the two processes inside this container.

Config.Name: Bridge URL
Config.Description: mywhoosh-garmin-bridge events endpoint, e.g. http://<unraid-ip>:8095/events. Leave empty to disable forwarding.

Config.Name: Bridge Secret
Config.Description: Must match BRIDGE_SECRET in the bridge container.

Config.Name: Bridge Athlete ID
Config.Description: Strava athlete ID whose new activities are forwarded to the bridge.

Config.Name: Telegram Bot Token
Config.Description: Bot token for alerts sent from the worker.

Config.Name: Node Options
Config.Description: Node heap cap; keep below the --memory limit in Extra Parameters.
